families.name: Vast Quiet Cinematic
families.definition: A monumental landscape with a small subject and empty sky or fog. Surrealism when the scene cannot be real, ethereal when it is mist and air, tenebrism when one dusk light does the contrast. Type stays thin.
always: A full-bleed landscape with empty sky or fog.
The subject stays small and low.
One accent at most, or none.
never: Bright buttons crowded into the sky.
Purple, neon, synthwave glow, or cybercore glitch.

families.name: Nature Photo Hero
families.definition: A real nature photograph fills the frame. Cottagecore when the land is rural and green, ethereal when it is fog or open air. A little interface may sit on the photo, such as a japandi-calm pill or one glassmorphic instrument.
always: At most one button, or one small instrument on the photo.
never: Painted scenery in place of the photograph.
A busy card grid over the photograph.
Purple gradients, neon, or synthwave color.

families.name: Painted Pastoral
families.definition: The scene is painted, not photographed. Cottagecore hills under an ethereal sky, with a serif headline.
always: An illustrated landscape with a soft sky.

families.name: Dark Studio Product
families.definition: Tenebrism for objects. One product in a black or charcoal void, spotlight or rim light, and a single accent or none.
always: Studio light, often a rim light or spotlight.
never: A daylight room or a lifestyle scene.

families.name: Light Studio Product
families.definition: One object on white, grey, or warm tan. Utilitarian when the page is specs and controls, luxury typography when a serif title carries it, glassmorphism when the cards are frosted, ethereal when the ground is mostly empty air.
always: One product on a light ground.
Soft daylight or even studio light.
never: A black void behind the product.
Neon, or a second bright accent.

families.name: Dark Tech Particle
families.definition: One particle form glowing on a near-black ground. Gold is the only light. This is not cybercore, synthwave, or an aurora rainbow.
always: Heavy type set off the form, with empty ground.
never: Daylight, or a physical product photograph.

families.name: Split Mono Editorial
families.definition: Brutalism cut into white and black. A giant index, vertical type, and one photograph crossing the seam.
always: A hard white and black split.
Vertical type on the dark side.

families.name: Mono Catalog
families.definition: A black-and-white catalog. Luxury typography asks the questions. Studio stills sit on plain grounds.
never: Halftone dots or a warm paper texture.

families.name: Earthen Palette
families.definition: Wabi sabi color: forest green, cream, beige, and clay, with real leaves. The cards are set out like a bento.
always: Earth-tone cards in sage, beige, and clay.
never: Neon, purple, or a pure black void.

families.name: Charcoal Utility
families.definition: Utilitarian panels in charcoal, drawn in thin white ink. At most one warm metal accent. Rounded blocks are fine. This is not a bright bento on white.
always: White or near-white ink and hairlines.

A huge pale moon sits partly behind it, a thin dark orbital ring curves across the frame, two small floating spheres hang in the air, and soft cumulus clouds drift through the arch. STRICT palette: slate dusk blue #3B4A63, misty blue-grey #8A97AD, pale peach glow #F2D1B3, cream highlight #FBEFE1, muted gold #D9B47A on rim edges only. Cool overall, warm only as a soft glow behind the arch. Lighting: low sun behind the arch, backlit, soft diffuse glow, long reflections. Camera: 35mm wide, eye level just above the water. Composition: arch and moon in the right half, figure small at the arch base, mirror-still reflective water and a thin dark walkway in the lower quarter, left 45% of the frame calm hazy sky kept empty for typography. Mood: calm, quiet, dreamlike. Avoid: orange sunset, saturated sky, ancient or crumbling stone, rocks, centered symmetry, purple, neon, lens flare, stars, text, logos, interface.
